review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one private definition, `bundledKernel`, and the rest are theorems that wrap `CircleKernelConvolution` lemmas. `bundledKernel` is only `ContinuousMap.mk` applied to `kernel H` and `continuous_kernel H`. It makes the kernel a `C(UnitAddCircle, ℝ)` so the generic convolution lemmas can take it. It doesn't compete with a Mathlib concept. The theorems are thin specialisations to the Fejér kernel, which the rubric says are not defects. Standalone theorem duplication is excluded from this rubric. I did not trace whether `Circle`, `approximation` or `kernel` (defined in imported files, not this one) duplicate Mathlib concepts. I only grepped for them in the project and found `Circle` used as an alias for `UnitAddCircle`. I found no justified finding.
